description: Document structure for Proposal/CHORUS-{situation-slug}.md (engage-chorus Step 5). Rendering: stakeholder briefs and the mediator landscape render as Markdown tables in the .md artefact; JSON Schema files (stakeholder-brief-schema.json, mediator-output-schema.json) govern validation only (#272).

sections.title: Metadata
sections.description: Render as a key-value list (`- **Key:** Value`).

sections.title: Situation
sections.description: Restated negotiation + decision at stake. Render as prose.

sections.title: Stakeholders
sections.description: One section per advocate. Each section: `### the-<role>` heading + a six-row Markdown table (rows = interests, statedPositions, batna, reservationPoint, tradeableConcessions, coalitionSignals) + prose paragraph for rationale + inline `**Steel-man tier:**`. Do NOT embed the brief as a fenced ```json``` block — the JSON Schema validates the structure, but the rendered artefact is a table (#272).

sections.title: Mediator Landscape
sections.description: Six Markdown tables, one per required section of mediator-output-schema.json: ZOPA `| Issue | Overlap |`; trade frontier `| Gives up | Stakeholder | In exchange for | Counterparty |`; settlement zones `| Rank | Outcome | Endorsed by |`; unresolved conflicts `| Conflict | Stakeholders |`; concession sequencing `| # | Stakeholder | Move | Tests |`; coalition map `| Members | Aligned interest |`. Do NOT embed as a fenced ```json``` block (#272).

sections.title: Recommended Concession Sequence
sections.description: Ordered moves for the user to test the deal space. Render as a numbered list.

sections.title: What Would Change This Landscape
sections.description: 2-3 bullets naming the assumption / stakeholder / constraint that would shift the recommendation. Render as a bullet list.
